# Artemis II lifts off from Kennedy Space Center

NASA's Orion spacecraft launched atop the Space Launch System rocket on the first crewed mission of the agency's Artemis campaign.

The Artemis II test flight launched from NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The mission will send NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen around the Moon and back to Earth.

fault.where: NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen
fault.note: The source text says Jeremy Hansen is a CSA (Canadian Space Agency) astronaut, not a NASA one.
